title: Why does my patient return? - Readmission of patients within 14 days of discharge from internal medicine in a standard and specialized care hospital: a descriptive analysis
summary: Unplanned readmissions after hospital discharge place a burden on patients and the healthcare system. Readmissions may be influenced by medical factors, errors in discharge management, patient-related factors, or deficiencies in follow-up care. This study aims to describe the frequency and characteristics of readmissions within 14 days of discharge from internal medicine departments and to explore potential associated factors.
conditions: All patients readmitted from the internal medicine departments within 14 days of the study period.  Exclusion criteria: Patients transferred to other hospitals or rehabilitation clinics. Planned readmissions within 14 days (e.g., planned surgeries, scheduled inpatient follow-up appointments).

interventions.name: Descriptive, retrospective observational study. No comparison or control arm.
